articles.summary: A new final rule from HHS, Labor, and the Treasury, which cites Serif Health as a source, aims to make price transparency files smaller and more usable by organizing rates by network, removing ghost rates, and improving out-of-network data.
articles.title: Ghost Rates, Be Gone: How the New TiC Rule Cleans Up Price Transparency

articles.summary: Payers sometimes publish facility fees under a professional label, and this post shows how those misclassified rates distort physician benchmarks and how Serif corrects them before the data reaches you.
articles.title: Are You Benchmarking the Surgeon or the Operating Room?
